title: Audio Player Cleanup on Disappear
requirements: Add .onDisappear { viewModel.audioPlayer.cleanup() } to EntryDetailView that stops the repeating Timer and releases the AVAudioPlayer reference
Ensure AudioPlayer.cleanup() is idempotent — safe to call multiple times (stop timer if running, set player = nil, reset currentPlaybackTime = 0)
If the user is mid-playback and navigates away, playback stops (no lingering AVAudioPlayer instance)
EntryDetailViewModel.onDisappear also persists the transcript via DiaryStore.update (existing behavior, preserved)
acceptance_criteria: After navigating away from an entry mid-playback, no AVAudioPlayer instance remains active (verifiable via Instruments / process inspection)
cleanup() can be called twice without side-effects
